method: Drafted from granite-docling output (pages 274 and 395, where the model looped and the text layer is garbage, typed from the page image), then each page read against its image (pdftoppm -r 110, with 220-300 dpi crops for small print) and every word where the draft and the PDF text layer disagree re-read at the image; footnote markers as [^n], notes in <label>.notes.txt. Line-end hyphens are rejoined (the printed words, including original misspellings: 'Charateristics', 'guildelines'). Indented questions and findings are separate paragraphs. Not a second independent transcription: see docs/design/2026-10-03-vision-structure-pass.md for the limits.
label: the page's %%page N%% label in full.md: the printed number. Files are named by PDF page, not label: a loader must map through pages[pdf].label
sample: golden: pages golden.yaml already verifies (the pipeline was tuned on them). random: python random.seed(20261003); random.sample(range(14,440) minus golden, 3) gave 92, 192, 274; 92 (a blank page, no text layer) and 192 (a diagram) have no words to check and were replaced by the first two text pages (>=150 layer words) of random.shuffle with the same seed: 96, 395; 274 kept
